keybindings.header.title: Keyboard and mouse bindings
keybindings.header.subtitle: Choose Edit for the regular workflow or click a binding value to capture input immediately. Valid changes apply at once; conflicts remain as drafts.
keybindings.chip.tooltip: Click to enter binding capture mode immediately.
keybindings.dialog.shortcut.title: Edit shortcut
keybindings.dialog.shortcut.note: Press the new shortcut. A conflict can be resolved safely after saving the draft.
keybindings.dialog.mouse.title: Edit mouse gesture
keybindings.dialog.mouse.note: Choose a button and modifier. A temporary conflict remains a draft.
keybindings.dialog.reset.title: Restore default bindings?
keybindings.dialog.reset.text: All changed keyboard shortcuts and mouse gestures will be replaced with their defaults.
keybindings.dialog.conflicts.title: Binding conflicts remain
keybindings.dialog.conflicts.text: Conflicting changes have not been applied. Return to fix them or discard only the conflicting drafts.
keybindings.dialog.change_failed.title: Could not change binding
keybindings.error.too_many_modifiers: Mouse gestures support at most one modifier.
keybindings.error.empty_sequence: Enter at least one key or shortcut.
keybindings.error.sequence_conflict: This shortcut is already used by another command.
keybindings.error.wheel_required: Zoom must remain assigned to the mouse wheel; its modifier may be changed.
keybindings.error.wheel_forbidden: The mouse wheel cannot be assigned to a click or drag action.
keybindings.error.mouse_conflict: This gesture is already used by another action in the same area.
keybindings.error.unsupported_format: The key bindings file uses an unsupported format.
keybindings.error.keyboard_conflicts_rep: Conflicting keyboard bindings in the file were restored to their defaults.
keybindings.error.mouse_conflicts_repair: Conflicting mouse gestures in the file were restored to their defaults.
keybindings.binding.delete_branch.title: Delete selected branch
keybindings.binding.delete_branch.descri: Opens confirmation for deleting the selected local branch and its subtree.
keybindings.binding.history_toggle.title: Undo or restore the latest change
keybindings.binding.history_toggle.descr: The first press undoes the latest step, the second restores it; repeated presses toggle between the before and after states.
keybindings.binding.undo_only.title: Walk backward through history
keybindings.binding.undo_only.descriptio: Always undoes one more step; holding the shortcut repeats undo.
keybindings.binding.nav_dashboard.title: Open dashboard
keybindings.binding.nav_dashboard.descri: Switches the application to the dashboard from any workspace.
keybindings.binding.nav_profiles.title: Open profiles
keybindings.binding.nav_profiles.descrip: Switches the application to the profiles workspace.
keybindings.binding.nav_agents.title: Open agents
keybindings.binding.nav_agents.descripti: Switches the application to the agents and versions lineage tree.
keybindings.binding.nav_datasets.title: Open datasets
keybindings.binding.nav_datasets.descrip: Switches the application to the datasets workspace.
keybindings.binding.nav_training.title: Open training
keybindings.binding.nav_training.descrip: Switches the application to the training workspace.
keybindings.binding.nav_snapshots.title: Open snapshots
keybindings.binding.nav_snapshots.descri: Switches the application to the snapshots and weights registry.
keybindings.binding.nav_tests.title: Open tests
keybindings.binding.nav_tests.descriptio: Switches the application to testing and portrait workflows.
keybindings.binding.nav_analysis.title: Open analysis
keybindings.binding.nav_analysis.descrip: Switches the application to result analysis.
keybindings.binding.nav_style.title: Open appearance
keybindings.binding.nav_style.descriptio: Switches the application to themes, accent and scaling controls.
keybindings.binding.nav_docs.title: Open documentation
keybindings.binding.nav_keybindings.desc: Switches the application to the keyboard and mouse binding editor.
keybindings.mouse_binding.open_node_menu: Selects a node and opens its embedded action menu directly on the canvas.
keybindings.mouse_binding.close_node_men: Closes the open menu by clicking empty canvas space.
keybindings.mouse_binding.pan_canvas_pri: Pans the graph workspace from empty canvas space.
keybindings.mouse_binding.pan_canvas_sec: Provides a second independent way to pan the workspace.
keybindings.mouse_binding.move_node.desc: Changes only the selected node's manual position.
keybindings.mouse_binding.move_subtree.d: Moves the selected node together with its descendants; the mode changes dynamically when the modifier is pressed.
keybindings.mouse_binding.zoom_canvas.de: Changes zoom around the cursor position.
